description: A bare synthetic read supplies its projected close to an explicit aligned query (engine §4 and §7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a (X [+T])
%rule b (X [+T] [+U])
%rule c $x:body %conditions $x.without-elision.matches(rival)

%rule body (X T)
%rule rival (X [+T])
